What would you like x2c to do, and why would it be useful?

Ideas are welcome. x2c is maintained by one person, so an issue does not
guarantee a response or put the idea on a roadmap. For security reports, follow
[SECURITY.md](https://github.com/gwf/x2c/blob/main/SECURITY.md) instead.
